name: Cover, title left
description: White cover: kicker, large left-aligned title, subtitle, a rule and author/date line.
use_when: Default opening for reports, reviews and proposals.
tags: cover title opening first slide intro report

name: Cover, dark
description: Full dark cover with white title, muted subtitle and meta line.
use_when: Executive or keynote opening that needs presence.
tags: cover dark black inverted keynote executive opening

name: Cover, typographic
description: Very large centred title between two thin rules, short line below, date at the bottom.
use_when: Short punchy title (two to five words), editorial or manifesto tone.
tags: cover typographic editorial big title centred manifesto

name: Cover, split image
description: Title block on the left half, full-height picture on the right half.
use_when: Opening that benefits from a strong photo (place, product, people).
tags: cover image photo split half picture visual opening

name: Cover, side band
description: Dark vertical band on the left third with context and date; title and subtitle on the right.
use_when: Formal opening with a strong structure; works well for board and committee decks.
tags: cover band sidebar vertical formal board committee

name: Agenda, numbered
description: Six numbered agenda items on a two-column grid, each with a short detail line.
use_when: Table of contents for decks with three to six parts.
tags: agenda contents summary outline plan sommaire numbered

name: Agenda, timed sessions
description: Rows of sessions with time, title and owner, separated by thin rules.
use_when: Workshop, seminar or meeting programme with times and speakers.
tags: agenda programme schedule workshop meeting times sessions speakers

name: Agenda, active chapter
description: Chapter list on the left with the current one highlighted; chapter number and title large on the right.
use_when: Reminder of where we are, between parts of a long deck.
tags: agenda progress chapter marker where we are navigation transition

name: Chapter divider, dark
description: Dark full slide with a large chapter number, chapter title and one framing line.
use_when: Start of a new part in decks of fifteen slides or more.
tags: divider section chapter break separator dark transition

name: Divider with key figure
description: Light divider: chapter title on the left, one large figure and its caption on the right.
use_when: Opening a chapter with the single number that motivates it.
tags: divider section key figure number hook chapter

name: Transition, seen and next
description: Two columns: what has been covered (muted) and what comes next (strong), split by a rule.
use_when: Bridge between the diagnosis and the proposal, or between two parts.
tags: transition recap next so far bridge seen coming up

name: Key message
description: One sentence set very large on an empty slide, with a short rule above and a source line.
use_when: The single takeaway the audience must remember; a turning point in the story.
tags: key message statement takeaway big sentence one idea headline

name: Figure and interpretation
description: A very large number on the left, its caption beneath, and the interpretation in a column on the right.
use_when: One fact carries the argument: show the number, then say what it means.
tags: figure number stat fact proof big number interpretation insight

name: Big quote
description: A large quotation in italics with a thick opening rule and the attribution below.
use_when: A customer, expert or leader said it better; use real quotes only.
tags: quote quotation testimonial citation voice customer verbatim

name: Strategic question
description: The question that frames the discussion, centred and large, with one line of context.
use_when: Opening a debate or a decision: state the question before the answers.
tags: question problem framing debate issue key question discussion

name: Position and three arguments
description: A position statement across the top, then three numbered arguments in columns.
use_when: Take a stand and back it with three reasons.
tags: position argument reasons three why recommendation stance thesis

name: Central figure with annotations
description: One very large number in the centre, four short annotations in the corners linked by thin rules.
use_when: A number that needs context from several angles (cause, trend, comparison, consequence).
tags: figure number annotations centre callouts context stat

name: Title and text
description: Title, framing line and one text block, with an optional side note.
use_when: A paragraph of explanation that does not split into parallel points.
tags: text paragraph explanation body narrative simple

name: Two columns
description: Two balanced text columns, each with a heading over a strong rule.
use_when: Two parallel ideas: problem and solution, today and tomorrow, two audiences.
tags: two columns comparison parallel side by side text pair

name: Three columns with icons
description: Three columns, each with an icon, a heading and a short text.
use_when: Three pillars, benefits, principles or offers of equal weight.
tags: three columns pillars icons benefits principles offers features

name: Four columns
description: Four narrow numbered columns separated by thin rules.
use_when: Four steps, levers or components that read left to right.
tags: four columns levers components steps numbered pillars

name: Four cards
description: A two-by-two grid of light cards, each with a heading and a short text.
use_when: Four items of equal weight that need a few lines each (findings, recommendations).
tags: four cards grid 2x2 findings recommendations blocks tiles

name: Main content and sidebar
description: Main text on the left two thirds, a grey sidebar with key points on the right.
use_when: Explanation plus the facts, definitions or figures the reader should keep.
tags: sidebar main content key points facts aside 70 30

name: Text with takeaway box
description: Explanatory text on the left, a dark box on the right holding the takeaway.
use_when: The reasoning matters but the conclusion must stand out.
tags: takeaway conclusion box highlight summary so what

name: Findings and implications
description: Three rows: a finding on the left, an arrow, its implication on the right.
use_when: Turning a diagnosis into consequences: what we saw, what it means.
tags: findings implications diagnosis so what consequences insight analysis

name: Problem and hypotheses
description: Problem statement in a grey band, three hypothesis cards below.
use_when: Framing an analysis: the problem and the hypotheses to test.
tags: problem hypotheses framing issue analysis plan test

name: Text and image
description: Title and text on the left, a full-height picture bleeding off the right edge.
use_when: A message that a photo makes concrete: a site, a product, a team at work.
tags: image photo picture text left visual right illustration

name: Full image with caption box
description: Full-bleed picture with a white box in the lower left holding a title and a short text.
use_when: Emotional or contextual moment carried by one strong picture.
tags: full image photo background bleed caption box visual impact

name: Case study
description: Square picture on the left; context and three result figures on the right.
use_when: Customer story, project reference or pilot with measurable results.
tags: case study customer story reference results testimonial pilot

name: Team of four
description: Four portraits in a row, each with name, role and a one-line focus.
use_when: Introducing the team, the speakers or the key contacts.
tags: team people portraits members speakers bios contacts staff

name: Full visual
description: Title, framing line and one wide frame for a chart or diagram from the visuals library.
use_when: The visual is the message and needs all the room (roadmap, process, big chart).
tags: frame chart diagram visual full width big graph roadmap

name: Visual and key points
description: Frame on the left two thirds; key points and a takeaway on the right.
use_when: A chart that needs reading help: what to look at and what it means.
tags: chart commentary key points side comment analysis frame graph

name: Visual with three callouts
description: Three short numbered callouts in a row above a wide frame.
use_when: A visual with three things to notice, read before looking at it.
tags: callouts highlights frame visual chart three insights

name: Two visuals
description: Two frames side by side, each with a heading and a caption.
use_when: Comparing two charts or diagrams: before and after, two segments, two periods.
tags: two charts compare side by side frames visuals pair dual

name: Visual and two figures
description: Frame on the left; two key figures stacked on the right.
use_when: A trend or breakdown with the two numbers that summarise it.
tags: chart kpi figures numbers frame visual summary

name: Dashboard, four modules
description: Two-by-two grid of frames, each with its own small heading.
use_when: Monitoring view: four indicators or charts read together.
tags: dashboard four modules monitoring overview grid charts kpis

name: Three figures
description: Three large figures in columns, each with label and context, over a strong rule.
use_when: Three numbers that tell the story of a period, a project or an offer.
tags: kpi three figures numbers metrics stats results key figures

name: Four figures on cards
description: Four grey cards in a row, each with a figure, its label and its variation.
use_when: Four indicators of a scorecard; each needs a short comparison.
tags: kpi four figures cards scorecard indicators variation metrics

name: Six figures
description: Three-by-two grid of compact figures with labels, separated by thin rules.
use_when: Overview of up to six indicators without charts.
tags: kpi six figures grid indicators overview numbers

name: Hero figure and breakdown
description: Dark left panel with one big figure; four breakdown lines with values on the right.
use_when: A total and what it is made of; a headline result and its drivers.
tags: hero kpi total breakdown drivers big number dark panel

name: Table and takeaway
description: Native table on the left two thirds, takeaway column on the right.
use_when: Detailed comparison or figures that must be read row by row, with the conclusion beside.
tags: table benchmark comparison grid data rows columns criteria

name: Action plan
description: Full-width table with action, owner, due date and status columns.
use_when: Who does what by when; follow-up of decisions.
tags: action plan table owner deadline status follow up todo raci

name: Two options
description: Two equal option cards with characteristics and a verdict line.
use_when: Choice between two scenarios presented neutrally.
tags: two options scenarios choice decision versus compare alternatives

name: Recommended option
description: Recommended option in a large dark card, the alternative in a smaller light card.
use_when: You recommend one option and show the alternative you discarded.
tags: recommendation recommended option preferred decision alternative asymmetric

name: Three options
description: Three option cards with characteristics and a verdict line.
use_when: Choice between three scenarios (do nothing, partial, full).
tags: three options scenarios choice decision compare alternatives

name: Before and after
description: Two columns, current state in grey and target state in black, joined by an arrow.
use_when: Transformation, as-is versus to-be, the change you propose.
tags: before after as is to be current target change transformation

name: Summary and decision
description: Four numbered key points on the left, the decision requested in a dark box on the right.
use_when: End of a decision deck: what to remember and what we ask for.
tags: summary conclusion key points decision ask wrap up synthesis

name: Next steps
description: Horizontal line with four dated steps, each with its owner.
use_when: Closing with what happens next and who does it.
tags: next steps actions timeline plan follow up dates owners

name: Thank you and contacts
description: Large closing line and up to three contacts with name, role and address.
use_when: Last slide: thanks, questions, who to contact.
tags: thank you contacts end closing questions last slide

name: Bento grid
description: Grid of five modules of different sizes; the main one is dark and holds a figure.
use_when: A rich overview (offer, results, programme) where one element dominates.
tags: bento grid mosaic modules overview tiles editorial modern

name: Horizontal bands
description: Three full-width bands alternating grey and white: label, heading and text on each.
use_when: Three themes or periods read top to bottom (past, present, future).
tags: bands horizontal rows three themes past present future layers

name: Story in four acts
description: Four acts in columns joined by a line: act number, title and short text.
use_when: Narrative arc: situation, complication, resolution, outcome.
tags: story narrative four acts storytelling arc situation complication resolution

name: Side panel
description: Dark panel on the left third with title and lead; two text columns on the right.
use_when: Dense content that needs a strong anchor; executive summaries.
tags: side panel dark sidebar executive summary editorial anchor

name: Vertical sequence
description: Title on the left; five numbered steps stacked on the right along a vertical line.
use_when: A method, procedure or chronology of up to five steps with a line of detail each.
tags: steps sequence vertical method procedure process numbered chronology

name: Ranked bars
description: Horizontal bars sorted from largest to smallest, values at the end of each bar.
use_when: Rank items on one measure (regions, products, causes). Best with 3 to 12 items.
tags: ranking bars horizontal sorted top leaderboard compare items

name: Two periods
description: Clustered columns: previous period in grey, current period in black, values on top.
use_when: Same items measured at two moments (year on year, before and after).
tags: compare periods year on year before after columns clustered two series

name: Progress to target
description: For each item a light bar shows the target and a dark bar over it shows the actual value.
use_when: Achievement against objectives for several teams, projects or indicators.
tags: target objective achievement progress actual versus goal bullet

name: Sensitivity tornado
description: Bars extending left (downside) and right (upside) of a central axis, largest effect on top.
use_when: Which assumptions move the result most: sensitivity analysis, risk drivers.
tags: tornado sensitivity upside downside risk drivers assumptions swing

name: Slope chart
description: Lines joining each item's value at two moments; the slope shows who gains and who loses.
use_when: Change in ranking or value between two dates for 3 to 7 items.
tags: slope before after change ranking two points lines gainers losers

name: Scored comparison
description: Options in columns, criteria in rows, a shaded dot per cell from light (weak) to black (strong).
use_when: Compare 2 to 4 options on 3 to 6 qualitative criteria; supplier or scenario choice.
tags: scoring comparison options criteria harvey balls evaluation matrix decision

name: Line with annotation
description: One bold line over time with a callout explaining the key moment.
use_when: A trend and the event that explains it (launch, crisis, policy change).
tags: line trend evolution time series annotation event over time

name: Stacked area
description: Stacked areas showing how a total and its components evolve.
use_when: Growth of a total and the changing weight of 2 to 4 components.
tags: stacked area composition over time mix evolution total components

name: Columns and line
description: Columns for a volume, a line on a second axis for a rate.
use_when: Volume and ratio together: revenue and margin, users and conversion.
tags: combo columns line dual axis volume rate margin

name: Plan versus actual
description: Cumulative plan as a light line, actual as a bold line that stops at today.
use_when: Project progress, budget burn, cumulative sales against plan (S-curve).
tags: plan actual s curve cumulative progress budget burn tracking forecast

name: Trend table
description: Four rows: indicator name, current value and a small trend line.
use_when: Several indicators whose direction matters more than their detail.
tags: sparklines trend table indicators small lines monitoring

name: Small multiples
description: Three small line charts on the same scale, side by side, each with its own heading.
use_when: The same trend for several segments; avoids a tangle of lines on one chart.
tags: small multiples segments panels trends comparison lines facets

name: Waterfall bridge
description: Bridge from a starting total to an ending total through increases (dark) and decreases (light).
use_when: Explain a variation: budget to actual, last year to this year, price walk.
tags: waterfall bridge walk variance contribution decomposition ebitda budget

name: Mix bars
description: 100% stacked horizontal bars showing the split of each item between components.
use_when: Compare the mix (shares) across groups: channels by region, cost structure by unit.
tags: mix share split 100 percent stacked bars composition structure

name: Donut with total
description: Donut chart with the total written in the centre.
use_when: Share of a total with 2 to 5 parts, when one part dominates.
tags: donut doughnut share split parts total proportion

name: Simple pie
description: Pie with two or three very unequal parts and their percentages.
use_when: One clear majority versus the rest ("two thirds of customers...").
tags: pie share majority part proportion simple

name: Funnel
description: Five stacked stages narrowing downwards, each with its label, value and conversion.
use_when: Conversion through successive stages: marketing, sales, recruitment, validation.
tags: funnel conversion stages pipeline drop off leads sales recruitment

name: Stacked columns
description: Columns stacked by component over a few periods.
use_when: Total and its composition for 3 to 8 periods (revenue by product per year).
tags: stacked columns composition periods total breakdown years

name: Scatter plot
description: Points placed by two measures, to reveal a correlation or outliers.
use_when: Is X linked to Y? Price and volume, effort and result, size and growth.
tags: scatter correlation relationship two measures outliers dots xy

name: Bubble portfolio
description: Bubbles placed on two axes, bubble size for a third measure (portfolio view).
use_when: Portfolio of products, projects or markets: attractiveness, position and size.
tags: bubble portfolio three measures bcg size attractiveness position

name: Histogram
description: Adjacent columns counting how many values fall in each range.
use_when: How values are spread: delays, order sizes, ages, scores.
tags: histogram distribution spread frequency ranges bins dispersion

name: Heatmap grid
description: Grid of cells, rows by columns, each cell shaded by its value and showing the number.
use_when: Intensity across two dimensions: activity by day and hour, sales by product and region, cohort retention.
tags: heatmap grid intensity matrix cohort retention shading cells two dimensions

name: Pareto
description: Sorted columns with a cumulative percentage line on a second axis.
use_when: Find the few causes that explain most of the effect (80/20).
tags: pareto 80 20 causes concentration cumulative quality priorities

name: KPI cards with change
description: Three cards with a figure, its label and the change against a reference.
use_when: A compact scorecard inside a slide that also carries text or a chart.
tags: kpi cards figures change delta variation scorecard metrics

name: Progress rings
description: Three rings, each filled to a percentage, with the figure in the centre and a label below.
use_when: Completion or achievement rates (percent of target, percent done).
tags: progress rings completion rate percentage achievement donut gauge

name: Figure with trend
description: One large figure with its label, change and a small area chart of its recent trend.
use_when: The headline figure of a slide, with just enough history to show the direction.
tags: kpi figure trend sparkline headline number history

name: Status list
description: Rows with a status dot, an item name, a short comment and an owner.
use_when: Project or programme status report (on track, at risk, late).
tags: status rag traffic light project report on track at risk late

name: Gauge
description: Half-ring gauge filled to a percentage, figure in the centre, scale ends below.
use_when: One rate against its maximum: capacity used, satisfaction score, budget consumed.
tags: gauge meter dial half donut rate capacity score

name: Two-by-two matrix
description: Four named quadrants on two axes, numbered markers placed inside, and a key on the right.
use_when: Position up to eight items on two criteria (value and feasibility, urgency and importance).
tags: 2x2 matrix quadrants positioning two criteria prioritisation grid

name: SWOT
description: Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats in four blocks, internal above, external below.
use_when: Summarise a diagnosis before choosing a strategy.
tags: swot strengths weaknesses opportunities threats diagnosis strategy

name: Impact and effort
description: Impact on the vertical axis, effort on the horizontal; quick wins, big bets, fill-ins and time sinks.
use_when: Choose which initiatives to launch first.
tags: impact effort prioritisation quick wins initiatives backlog choose

name: Risk matrix
description: Five-by-five grid of likelihood and impact, shaded from light to dark, with numbered risks placed in it.
use_when: Risk register summary for a project, a programme or a decision.
tags: risk matrix likelihood impact probability heat criticality register

name: Nine-box grid
description: Three-by-three grid with a name and a short text in each box; darker towards the top right.
use_when: Segment people, products or markets on two three-level scales (performance and potential).
tags: nine box 9 box grid talent performance potential segmentation 3x3 ge mckinsey

name: Positioning map
description: Two crossing axes with labelled ends; numbered markers place each player or offer.
use_when: Competitive positioning, perception maps, where we stand against alternatives.
tags: positioning map perception competitors axes market landscape

name: Chevron process
description: Five chevrons in a row, the current one dark, with a short text under each.
use_when: A linear method or phases of a project, 3 to 5 steps.
tags: chevron process steps phases method linear stages arrows

name: Cycle
description: Four steps arranged on a circle with arrows, the centre naming the cycle.
use_when: A recurring loop: continuous improvement, planning cycle, customer lifecycle.
tags: cycle loop circular recurring continuous improvement pdca lifecycle

name: Swimlane flow
description: Three horizontal lanes (one per actor) with process boxes and arrows passing between lanes.
use_when: Who does what in a process with hand-offs: approval workflows, order to cash.
tags: swimlane flow workflow actors roles hand off process map approval

name: Stage-gate
description: Four stages as bars separated by diamond decision gates, with criteria under each gate.
use_when: Development or investment process with go / no-go decisions.
tags: stage gate phase gate go no go decision milestones innovation development

name: Customer journey
description: Journey stages in columns; rows for actions, touchpoints and pain points.
use_when: Map an experience end to end: customer, employee or user journey.
tags: customer journey experience stages touchpoints pain points user map

name: Double diamond
description: Two diamonds side by side: diverge then converge on the problem, then on the solution.
use_when: Design or innovation method: discover, define, develop, deliver.
tags: double diamond design thinking diverge converge discover define develop deliver innovation

name: Staircase
description: Four rising steps, darker as they climb, each with a level name and its description.
use_when: Maturity levels, capability growth, a progression plan.
tags: staircase maturity levels progression steps growth capability ladder

name: Milestone timeline
description: Horizontal line with six milestones alternating above and below, each with date and label.
use_when: Key dates of a project, a history, a launch plan.
tags: timeline milestones dates history chronology key dates

name: Roadmap by lanes
description: Workstreams in rows, four periods in columns; each cell holds the work planned.
use_when: Multi-stream roadmap over quarters or years.
tags: roadmap lanes workstreams quarters plan streams programme

name: Gantt chart
description: Tasks as horizontal bars positioned on a time axis (native chart, editable).
use_when: Detailed schedule with tasks and durations.
tags: gantt schedule tasks durations planning project timeline bars

name: Three horizons
description: Three overlapping blocks rising over time: core today, emerging next, future options.
use_when: Balance short-term performance with mid- and long-term growth (portfolio, innovation).
tags: three horizons h1 h2 h3 innovation growth portfolio future core

name: Now, next, later
description: Three columns from dark to light: what we do now, next and later, as short lists.
use_when: Product or programme roadmap without committed dates.
tags: now next later roadmap product priorities horizon backlog

name: Serpentine timeline
description: Eight numbered steps on a path that snakes across three rows, each with a label above and a short text below.
use_when: A long sequence that a single line would cram: a programme of six to eight phases, a history, an onboarding path.
tags: serpentine snake s path timeline steps phases sequence journey long process roadmap

name: Organisation chart
description: One head box, four boxes below, two sub-boxes under each, joined by elbow lines.
use_when: Organisation, governance or team structure on three levels.
tags: org chart organisation hierarchy team structure reporting lines governance

name: Logic tree
description: Question on the left, three branches, each splitting into two leaves on the right.
use_when: Break a problem or objective into its drivers (issue tree, KPI tree, decision tree).
tags: logic tree issue tree driver tree decomposition mece problem solving kpi tree

name: Pyramid
description: Four stacked levels narrowing to the top, with a description beside each level.
use_when: Hierarchy of needs, priorities or foundations (vision to operations).
tags: pyramid levels hierarchy foundations layers priorities vision

name: Layered architecture
description: Four horizontal layers with a label on the left and up to four blocks per layer.
use_when: System, data or operating model architecture; stack of capabilities.
tags: architecture layers stack system platform capabilities operating model technology

name: Hub and spoke
description: A central circle linked to six satellites, each with a short label.
use_when: Ecosystem around a core: partners, stakeholders, services around a platform.
tags: hub spoke ecosystem stakeholders partners centre satellites network platform

name: Venn diagram
description: Three overlapping translucent circles with a label in each and one at the centre.
use_when: Where three domains meet: the sweet spot, a skills profile, a value proposition.
tags: venn overlap intersection sweet spot three circles sets

name: Fishbone
description: Cause-and-effect diagram: a spine to the effect on the right, six cause categories as bones.
use_when: Root cause analysis of a quality, delay or performance problem.
tags: fishbone ishikawa cause effect root cause quality analysis 6m

name: Concentric circles
description: Three nested circles from the core outwards, with a label for each ring on the side.
use_when: Scope or influence by distance: core business, adjacent, ecosystem; TAM SAM SOM.
tags: concentric circles core rings scope tam sam som influence layers

name: Half-ring layers
description: A dark half disc at the base wrapped by three nested half rings, each layer named at its top.
use_when: Layers that build outwards from a core: capabilities around a product, circles of stakeholders, foundations to reach.
tags: half ring radial layers semicircle arch core onion nested levels foundations rainbow

name: Business model canvas
description: The nine blocks of the business model canvas in their standard arrangement.
use_when: Describe or compare business models.
tags: business model canvas bmc value proposition segments revenue costs osterwalder

name: Five forces
description: Industry rivalry in the centre, the four outside forces around it with arrows pointing inwards.
use_when: Assess the attractiveness of an industry or segment.
tags: five forces porter industry rivalry suppliers buyers substitutes entrants competition

name: PESTEL
description: Six columns for political, economic, social, technological, environmental and legal factors.
use_when: Scan the external environment before a strategy or a market entry.
tags: pestel pestle macro environment political economic social technological environmental legal

name: RACI matrix
description: Activities in rows, roles in columns, R, A, C or I in each cell; R and A shaded darker.
use_when: Clarify who is responsible, accountable, consulted and informed.
tags: raci responsibility accountable consulted informed roles governance matrix

name: OKR tree
description: One objective on top, three key results below, each with its target and progress.
use_when: Present objectives and key results, or any goal with measurable outcomes.
tags: okr objectives key results goals targets measurable outcomes

name: Value chain
description: Support activities as bars on top, five primary activities as chevrons below, margin at the end.
use_when: Where value is created in a company; locate costs, strengths or improvements.
tags: value chain porter primary support activities margin operations

name: Meshing gears
description: Three meshing gears of decreasing size with a label in each hub and a short text beside each.
use_when: Signature metaphor, only on request or when the idea is that parts drive each other: a mechanism, teams or levers working together.
tags: signature metaphor gears cogs mechanism machine engine levers interlocking working together drive

name: Light bulb
description: An outlined light bulb with the idea written in the glass and three short labels at the ends of its rays.
use_when: Signature metaphor, only on request or when the slide introduces one idea and its three facets: an insight, an innovation, a proposal.
tags: signature metaphor light bulb idea insight innovation creativity eureka proposal

name: Puzzle
description: Four interlocking jigsaw pieces in a two by two square, each holding a label and a short text.
use_when: Signature metaphor, only on request or when four parts must fit together to make the whole: a solution, an offer, a team.
tags: signature metaphor puzzle jigsaw pieces fit together complete solution components integration

name: Winding road
description: A road winding from left to right with four signposts standing on it, each sign naming a milestone.
use_when: Signature metaphor, only on request or when the story is a journey: a transformation path, a programme told as a road ahead.
tags: signature metaphor road route path journey signposts milestones way ahead transformation

name: Mountain and summit flag
description: A faceted mountain with three numbered steps up its left slope and a flag on the summit naming the goal.
use_when: Signature metaphor, only on request or when the message is an ambition reached in stages: a target state, a long climb, a vision.
tags: signature metaphor mountain summit peak flag climb ambition goal vision ascent steps

name: Target
description: A bullseye of three rings around a dark centre holding the main label, an arrow in the centre and a leader from each ring to its label.
use_when: Signature metaphor, only on request or when the message is focus on one aim: the objective, the core target and what surrounds it.
tags: signature metaphor target bullseye aim focus objective goal precision hit
